Senses.Explanation: Literally, the eyebrows (眉毛) fall out (墮落). The exact phrase occurs four times in four allowlisted texts; all four are preserved here. The wider family includes "the eyebrows fall" (眉毛落, 40 occurrences), "are the eyebrows still there?" (眉毛在麼, 79), and "the eyebrows become tangled together" (眉毛廝結, 129). Chan records use the loss of eyebrows as a stated consequence or accusation attached to handling Buddhist or Chan speech: one comment says that making a Buddhist teaching-discussion of a line "implicates Shimen, whose eyebrows fall out" (若作佛法商量，累他石門眉毛墮落); another points to "the place where Cuiyan's eyebrows fall out" while reviewing the Cuiyan exchange. A question joins the phrase to Danxia's burning of the wooden Buddha and asks why the monastery director's eyebrows fall out. The exact phrase is late and sparse, but its eyebrow-loss family is widely transmitted; the texts do not provide an anatomical explanation, and this entry adds none.
Senses.Note: All four exact witnesses are late records. The broader eyebrow formulas supply family breadth but are not substituted as occurrences for the exact headword. PreferredTarget remains literal; 'penalty for false teaching' is too narrow because the exact witnesses attach it to several different recorded speech/case contexts.

Occurrences.Kwic: 趨炎附暖底不顧爛額焦頭、添薪熾炭底那管眉毛墮落？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 內紹種禪師語錄, hall address on Baizhang, Longtan, Deshan, and Linji. Neishao Zhong is the exact speaker: he says those adding fuel and blazing coals pay no heed to their eyebrows falling out.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拈云：「若作佛法商量，累他石門眉毛墮落。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 南海寶象林慧弓詗禪師語錄, comment on an old case. Huigong Xiong is the exact commenting speaker: he says that discussing the case as buddha-dharma would implicate Shimen and make Shimen's eyebrows fall out.

Occurrences.Kwic: 看這翠巖眉毛墮落處自救不了，復有三元龍象互相蹴踏，
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 東山破峰重禪師語錄, hall address raising Cuiyan's end-of-retreat eyebrow case. Pofeng Puzhong is the exact framing and commenting speaker: after quoting Cuiyan, Changqing, Baofu, and Yunmen, he says Cuiyan cannot save himself where his eyebrows fall out and then tests his own assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「丹霞燒木佛，院主為甚麼眉毛墮落？」師云：「脫體風光。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 灤州萬善暉州昊禪師語錄. The exact actor is an unnamed monk: 進云 introduces the eyebrow-loss question. No personal name remains after the six-rung review.
